text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and I’d love to help you turn this idea into a practical all-in-one platform for print-on-demand store owners.

Your concept makes a lot of sense: bringing together AI tools for copywriting, image generation, product selection, ad support, and print-on-demand fulfillment into one compact workflow can save users a huge amount of time and reduce the friction of getting started. I understand the goal is not to invent entirely new tools, but to integrate existing ones into a clean experience that helps non-experts move from idea to store-ready product faster.

I have 6 years of experience working with Python and machine learning tools, including PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, and pandas. That background is a strong fit for building AI-driven products that connect multiple services into one user-friendly system.

One relevant project I built was a Contract clause search assistant for a confidential legal client. It used Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI to answer questions over 9,000 contracts while always quoting the clause and page used. It achieved 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set and reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That project required structuring complex AI workflows, integrating APIs, and designing a reliable user experience around generated outputs.

For your platform, I’d focus on making the system modular so it can connect to different AI services as needed. That could include chat-based assistance for product research and ad targeting, prompt support for image generation, and integrations with printful or printify APIs for product placement. I’d also think carefully about the user flow so someone with limited design or marketing experience can get value quickly without feeling overwhelmed.

If you’d like, I can help you think through the architecture and the best way to sequence the MVP so you can launch a useful version quickly and expand from there.
